summary.name: Ellipsis
summary.one_liner: Ellipsis is a managed cloud service that runs Claude Code agents, defined as YAML config files in your repository, to build features, fix bugs, and investigate production issues.
keywords: run coding agent on pull request
use_cases: Check pull requests for missing test coverage
Build features from a prompt in a repository
Run scheduled or event-triggered coding agents
summary.what_it_does: Ellipsis lets you define agents as YAML config files in a repository, specifying a trigger (for example, a pull request being pushed), a Claude Code session with model and prompt, the environment (repositories and setup hooks such as installing dependencies), compute resources (CPU and memory), and a budget per session and per day. The example on the page shows an agent that runs when a PR is pushed and checks changed API routes for missing test coverage. Ellipsis runs these agents in the cloud to build features, fix bugs, and investigate production issues. The page describes the prompt, environment, permissions, and budget as being set in YAML.
notable: Agents defined as YAML config files stored in the repository
Triggers such as pull request pushes
Configurable cloud compute (CPU and memory) and setup hooks
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page text is mostly a product example; platform support beyond the web is not described
